title: Standards Capsule
description: Machine-readable manifest linking a target repo to its upstream copilot-quickstart standards and encoding local file layout.

upstream.description: Reference to the copilot-quickstart standards this repo follows.

ref.description: Git ref (tag or branch) the repo is pinned to.

docs_base_url.description: URL prefix for linking to source-of-truth documents.

local.description: Paths to local config files, relative to the repo root. These tell meta-skills where to find/place artifacts.

agents_doc.description: Path to the AGENTS.md documentation file.

repo_instructions.description: Path to the repo-wide Copilot instructions file.

meta_skills_root.description: Directory where meta-skills live (if vendored locally).

installed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the capsule was first installed.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last CLI update to this file.
